title: SpeakersFile
description: Who can speak in a dialogue CSV and how they are shown (build plan P5). The key is the speaker column of the CSV; the display name is the string "speaker.<key>" in content/strings. The operator is not listed: it only replies, with no portrait.

style.description: box: the dialogue box with a name tag. memo: a sticky note and no box, for the liver who never speaks aloud (art direction 6.2).

portrait.description: True when public/assets/portraits/portrait-<key>-<expression>.png exists for every expression the CSV uses; false for a speaker shown by name tag alone.
